name: The Revalie
about:
The Revalie offers elegant student housing in Ottawa at 770 Brookfield Road, Ottawa, Ontario K1V 6J4. The fully furnished apartments include high-speed Wi-Fi, central air conditioning, and a fitness centre. There is also a free daily shuttle to Carleton University and back during the weekdays, plus weekly grocery runs. The Revalie Ottawa is close to Carleton University and is a 15-minute drive to the University of Ottawa. Algonquin College is also within a short drive from the building. The apartment complex itself is a vibrant micro-community. The spacious courtyard and the terrace lounge with its expansive views are the heart of community activities. From summer barbecue parties to winter holiday gatherings, the apartment management team regularly organises various social programs to help you quickly break down social barriers and find like-minded friends. Even if you just want to quietly read a book, the comfortable seating areas and collaborative study rooms scattered throughout the complex provide the perfect sanctuary. AmenitiesThe Revalie prioritises both privacy and convenience. Whether you choose a private or shared layout, every suite is fully furnished and move-in ready, featuring comfortable double beds and dedicated study stations. Life here is upgraded with in-unit laundry (no more sharing!), stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and a 55-inch smart TV. Plus, building-wide high-speed Wi-Fi 6 ensures you stay connected for both study and entertainment without interruption.With over 20,000 square feet of common space, Revalie Ottawa offers unmatched amenities. Skip the external gym membership and use the 6,500-square-foot fitness centre, complete with yoga and Pilates studios. Unique highlights include a Content Creation Studio for creatives and a commercial-grade Chef’s Kitchen for hosting dinner parties. You’ll also find game rooms, social lounges.For resident peace of mind, security is also a standard feature here at The Revalie apartments in Ottawa. Electronic access control systems and 24-hour security and maintenance services provide peace of mind, making you feel at home even in a foreign country. Even small details, such as package delivery, are covered, with smart parcel lockers ensuring the safe delivery of all your online purchases.Location and What's Hot
The surroundings of The Revalie offer a range of dining options, pubs, shopping centres, and parks. Some popular restaurants include House of Greek, Hog's Back Restaurant, and Thai Coconut. The hot pubs include O'Brien's Eatery & Pub and Hometown Sports Grill. 
Studying abroad shouldn't just be about going back and forth between two places; immersing yourself in local life is the essence of experiencing Canada. The Revalie's location cleverly balances urban convenience with natural beauty. The apartments are adjacent to the Rideau River and the famous Mooney's Bay Park and beach. Imagine spending a summer afternoon sunbathing on the beach with a few friends, or jogging or kayaking along the riverbank – that's the true Ottawa lifestyle.Transportation
Getting around the Revalie is easy for residents. From the Revalie, the closest bus stations are Brookfield / Hobson and Canada Post / Brookfield Station.
LRT (Train)
Mooney’s Bay Station: 11 minutes walk
Bus
Brookfield / Hobson: 3-minute walk
Shuttle 
Revalie → Carleton University: 1.8 km away
Airport
Ottawa International Airport (YOW): 7.4 km away
Universities nearby:
Carleton University: 2.3 km away
Algonquin College: 6.9 km away
University of Ottawa: 7.2 km away
In short, The Revalie Ottawa is more than just a place to sleep; it's a high-end student community that integrates living, learning, entertainment, and socializing. If you want your study abroad experience in Ottawa to get off to a winning start, then this is undoubtedly your wisest choice.

name: Alma Byward Market Ottawa
about:
Alma Byward Market Ottawa offers prime student apartments in Ottawa at 256 Rideau St, Ottawa, Ontario K1N 5Y3. University of Ottawa is an 8-minutes walk from the apartment and a 13-minute drive to Carleton University. The fully furnished student apartment provides studios and single rooms in a shared flat for you to choose from and live in the unit with high-speed Wi-Fi. 
 
In Alma Byward Market Ottawa, you can find many contemporary room amenties for a better living experience. In the warm bedroom, there is a king-size bed, nightstand, table lamp, wardrobe, and window. The clean bathroom includes a bathtub, toilet, mirror, wash basin, and towel rack. The modern kitchen space at 256 Rideau St has a fridge, microwave, oven, gas stove, dishwasher, sink, and food cabinets. The living room includes a dining table with chairs, a flat-screen TV, a desk and chair, a soft sofa, and an in-unit washer and dryer. The shared communities at Alma Byward Market Ottawa have a bike storage, games room, cardio and weight room, study lounge, outdoor rooftop, and penthouse sky lounge. 
 
Near Alma Byward Market Ottawa, you can find many restaurants, pubs, coffee shops, green spaces, and shopping centers. Gabriel Pizza, Hong Kong Express, Sushi Village, and Lone Star Texas Grill are the popular dining options near the apartment. Avant-Garde Bar & Gift Shop and The Laff are well-known pubs with many live music shows to discover. Metro Rideau and Farm Boy are convenient stores for food, drinks, and necessities. CF Rideau Center is a 6-minute drive from 256 Rideau St, and you can enjoy a fun shopping experience. The closest bus station from Alma Byward Market Ottawa is Rideau / Dalhousie station, a 3-minute walk distance from your home. Ottawa station is the nearest train station close to your apartment.

name: 1 Eleven
about:
1 Eleven provides modern and all-inclusive student housing in Ottawa at 111 Cooper St, Ottawa, Ontario K2P 2E3. This furnished apartment offers central air, high-speed WiFi, and various room types. 111 Cooper St Ottawa is close to the University of Ottawa, within a 15-minute walk, and Carleton University is a short bus ride from the apartment. The all-inclusive rent includes water, heating, internet, and gas. 
 
1 Eleven equipped fully furnished Quad, Double, Single, Single Deluxe, Single Platinum, and 2-bedroom apartments. All the units include air conditioning and heating to enhance your living environment. In your warm bedroom at 1 Eleven, you can find a queen-size bed, bedside table, table lamp, closet, desk and chair, heating, and window. The clean bathroom space comes with a bathtub, towel rack, toilet, wash basin, and mirror. For the spacious living room, you can find an end table, a large sofa, a flat-screen TV, a floor lamp, and a dining table with chairs. 111 Cooper St Ottawa offers a practical kitchen with a refrigerator, microwave, oven, dishwasher, sink, and food cabinets. The shared communities at 111 Cooper Street include a fitness center, yoga studio, game room, and study lounge.
 
Regarding public transportation near 1 Eleven, you can find the closest bus station at Elgin / Lisgar station, and the nearest train station is the Ottawa station. Many dining options, bars, and cafes are available near 1Eleven Ottawa. Some good dining options include Cooper's, The Whalesbone Elgin Street, and Johnny Farina. The popular bars include Deacon Brodies Pub and Abby's Wine Bar. Two convenient markets, Farm Boy and Arum Korean Market (Downtown), are where you can buy daily necessities.

name: THEO
about:
Theo Ottawa offers prime Ottawa student housing in the heart of downtown, with fully furnished 1- to 4-bedroom apartments. Located at 305 Rideau St, Ottawa, Ontario K1N 5Y6, Theo Apartments is close to the University of Ottawa with a 8-minute walk distance, and it is close to Carleton University with a 15-minute driving distance. Theo Residence offers all-inclusive rent; the utility bills include water, gas, and hydro. If you're tired of outdated apartment facilities and don't want to deal with the hassle of utility bills, then THEO might be the ideal first stop after arriving in Ottawa.Community
Theo Ottawa offers a variety of furnished unit types, from one to four-bedroom apartments. Whether you choose a private 1b to focus on your thesis or a shared suite to split the cost with roommates, the design logic here is simple: autonomy without the hassle. You won't find mismatched thrift-store furniture here. Every suite is a "turnkey" home, featuring Queen-size beds and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood your space with natural light. The real magic happens in the kitchen. Because you are located right across from Loblaws and minutes from the ByWard Market, you have Ottawa’s best fresh food at your doorstep. THEO Ottawa completes the picture with a culinary setup that actually inspires you to cook—think stainless steel appliances, ample cabinet space, and yes, a dishwasher. No more arguing over dirty plates during exam week. It’s a space where you can go from grocery aisle to hosting a dinner party in minutes, binge-watch Netflix on a comfortable sofa, and feel completely anchored in the heart of Ottawa.
 What truly sets Theo Apartments Ottawa apart from a standard rental is its "Vertical Campus" concept. The building is engineered to support both your GPA and your social life without requiring you to step outside. The dedicated study lounges and co-working spaces provide a quiet sanctuary away from the distractions of your bedroom. It’s like having a library right in your elevator ride. When it’s time to decompress, the amenities shift gears to wellness and recreation. The state-of-the-art fitness centre eliminates the need for a separate gym membership, offering cardio and weight equipment tailored for a full-body workout. Beyond fitness, the Theo residence's social spaces—including a games room and communal lounges—serve as the building's social heartbeat. These are the spaces where neighbours become friends, hosting everything from impromptu movie nights to organised resident events. The goal is to combat the isolation that international students sometimes feel by fostering a genuine sense of belonging.Location and What's Hot
THEO Apartments is really close to the uOttawa. It is also in the middle of Ottawas commercial centre. You can walk to the ByWard Market in about 9 minutes. The Rideau Centre shopping mall is a 10-minute walk away. If you need to buy groceries, there are two supermarkets near 305 Rideau Street. These are Aisle 24 Market and Fairway Trading Co. This is great because your daily life will not be limited to campus. You will have THEO Apartments and all these other places to explore. THEO residence is a place to live because it is close to everything you need. On weekend mornings, people who live in THEO Ottawa can go to the market to buy fruits and vegetables.
At night, there are a lot of restaurants, cafes and fun places to go out. You can eat at LA LA Noodles, ParLê, by Viet Fresh, Level One Game. Peking Duck they are all popular. If you want to relax you can go to Happy Goat Coffee Co. In Sandy Hill or Byward Café they are really places to unwind. You are steps away from 24-hour grocery stores like Loblaws, distinct coffee shops for your caffeine fix, and the diverse culinary scene of Rideau Street. Whether you need to grab bubble tea after class, shop at the Rideau Centre, or explore the nightlife of the ByWard Market, everything is within a walkable radius. For those venturing further, such as to Carleton University, the extensive OC Transpo public transit network is easily accessible, connecting you to the broader region.Attractions nearby THEO Ottawa:
Ottawa Art Gallery: 9-minute walk
National Gallery of Canada: 1.4 km away
Confederation Park: 1.1 km away
Parliament Hill: 1.0 km away from THEO. At night, the historical site is solemn, stunning, unforgettable.
 Safe and Management
 To keep you safe, Theo Ottawa provides 24-hour security services. The building features controlled access and a professional management team on-site to handle everything from parcel collection to maintenance requests. Unlike renting from individual landlords where repairs can take weeks, living at THEO Ottawa means having access to a responsive maintenance team. Transportation
THEO at 305 Rideau Street in the heart of Downtown has a high transit score. For public transportation near Theo Ottawa, the closest bus station is King Edward / George, a 7-minute walk, and the nearest train station is the Ottawa station.
